newsitem.title: USA: Tropical storm Josephine threatens in US Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm Josephine threatens in US Gulf.

text.p: A tropical storm watch is up for the Florida Gulf Coast from Apalachicola to Venice as Tropical Storm Josephine threatens, private forecaster Weather Services Corp. said.
Josephine had 45 mph winds and was centred about 300 miles to the south of New Orleans, Louisiana, moving east northeast near 13 mph, it said.
An increase in forward speed and a turn to the northeast should bring Josephine toward northwestern Florida, with landfall expected overnight. Top winds might reach or exceed 50 mph before landfall.
Josephine was a threat to shipping but would also spread a large area of heavy rain and potential flooding over the eastern Gulf Coast Monday.
